facts.text: The hotel has a peaceful lakeside setting in Tu Liem Ward, Hanoi.

facts.text: The hotel sits beside the Vietnam National Convention Center in western Hanoi.

facts.text: The historic center is roughly a 30- to 40-minute drive from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Carlos Zapata.

facts.text: The cantilevered building takes inspiration from Vietnam's coastline and the image of a dragon rising beside the water.

facts.excerpt: Guided by our chefs, you'll learn to make some Vietnamese dishes by using the fresh, home-growth herbs from our gardens.
